name: fixed-point spectral construction

phase_0.boundary_condition: The terminal anchor ⊣ (TANCH) is the fixed-point spectral construction itself, a self-referential cyclic closure where the boundary encodes the bulk information, collapsing degrees of freedom into a single register.

⊢.justification: The void state ∅ represents the uninitialized spectral basis before the fixed-point construction begins, corresponding to the scale V₋₁ = ONE.

⊣.justification: The terminal anchor ⊤ is the completed fixed-point state where the system is kinetically frozen and resists rearrangement without external driving.

≻.justification: The forward morphism ηₙ lifts a value from scale Vₙ to Vₙ₊₁ as a marked singleton, carrying the re-entry marker upward.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism μₙ reads the carried value back down from Vₙ₊₁ to Vₙ, forgetting the re-entry marker bit.

⋈.justification: The composition ρₙ₊₁ = ηₙ ∘ μₙ chains the transport and reveal to form the frame collapse, an idempotent retraction that identifies every member of the fibre.

⊙.justification: The identity ⊙ denotes the critical phase where the system resides at the threshold with scale-free correlations, explicitly denoting the self-referential nature of the fixed point.

∈.justification: The co-multiplication δ splits the ambient state into the Boolean core branches: the truth arm (T) and the falsity arm (F), representing the two canonical adjoints r and c.

∋.justification: The multiplication μ reconstitutes the arms into a single verdict; conflicting arms (r mapping B to T and c mapping B to F) rejoin to the B state, confirming the Boolean impossibility theorem.

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm evaluates the reflector r, which maps the gap N and the glut B to True, enforcing the truth-order reflection.

⊥.justification: The negative arm evaluates the coreflector c, which maps the gap N and the glut B to False, enforcing the truth-order coreflection.

⊞.justification: The paradice state holds the contradiction B simultaneously, representing the ambient both-value where the closure Inc(v) = B is held without resolution.

⊡.justification: The permanent record fixes the integer-valued topological invariant (winding number) that prevents continuous deformation to a trivial state without closing the spectral gap.

phase_3.void_description: The uninitialized spectral basis V₋₁ = ONE, before any scale recursion or fixed-point construction.
phase_3.true_description: The Boolean core state T, representing the affirmative arm where the reflector r maps the ambient state to True.
phase_3.false_description: The Boolean core state F, representing the negative arm where the coreflector c maps the ambient state to False.
phase_3.both_description: The dialetheic state B, representing the ambient both-value where the closure Inc(v) = B is held, and the Boolean impossibility theorem is verified.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the spectral basis as the void state ∅, representing the scale V₋₁ = ONE before any construction.
Apply the punctum transport η₋₁ to lift the void state to V₀ = TWO, carrying the re-entry marker.
Split the ambient state into the two canonical adjoints: the reflector r and the coreflector c.
Evaluate the reflector r on the T-arm, mapping the gap N and glut B to True.
Evaluate the coreflector c on the F-arm, mapping the gap N and glut B to False.
Rejoin the conflicting arms (T and F) into the B state, confirming the Boolean impossibility theorem.
Compose the transport and reveal to form the frame collapse ρ₀ = η₋₁ ∘ μ₋₁, an idempotent retraction.
Apply the punctum transport η₀ to lift the state to V₁ = FOUR, increasing the winding number.
Assert the self-reference ⊙ at the critical phase where the system resides at the threshold with scale-free correlations.
Hold the dialetheic witness B, representing the ambient both-value where the closure Inc(v) = B is maintained.
Fix the winding number w(V₁) = 2 as a permanent topological invariant.
Apply the punctum transport η₁ to lift the state to V₂ = SIXTEEN₃, further increasing the scale.
Chain the frame collapse ρ₁ = η₀ ∘ μ₀ to identify every member of the fibre with the marked singleton.
Split the state again to evaluate the union and intersection frame collapses ρ^∪ and ρ^∩.
Evaluate the union frame collapse ρ^∪ on the T-arm, mapping N to F and B to T.
Evaluate the intersection frame collapse ρ^∩ on the F-arm, mapping N to T and B to F.
Rejoin the arms to the B state, confirming the distinct actions of the frame collapses on the ambient state.
Fix the winding number w(V₂) = 3 as a permanent topological invariant.
Apply the punctum transport η₂ to lift the state to V₃ = TWO₁₆, continuing the re-entry tower.
Compose the frame collapse ρ₂ = η₁ ∘ μ₁ to maintain the idempotent retraction at the new scale.
Assert the self-reference ⊙ at the new scale, maintaining the scale-free correlations.
Hold the dialetheic witness B, representing the ambient both-value at the higher scale.
Fix the winding number w(V₃) = 4 as a permanent topological invariant.
Anchor the system at the fixed-point spectral construction, a self-referential cyclic closure where the boundary encodes the bulk information.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The re-entry tower translation lemma δ = η, which translates domain intentions into operations by equating the Frobenius comultiplication with the punctum transport.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The canonical adjoints r ⊣ i ⊣ c, which mediate communication between the paraconsistent ambient and the Boolean core.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The frame collapse ρₙ₊₁ = ηₙ ∘ μₙ, which stores state by identifying every member of the fibre with the marked singleton.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The scale recursion Vₙ → Vₙ₊₁, which determines the order and timing of operations by increasing the winding number.
phase_5.alfs_store: The complete chain of scales ONE → TWO → FOUR → SIXTEEN₃ → TWO₁₆ → ..., serving as the canonical reference for the fixed-point spectral construction.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The re-entry marker bit, which is consumed per operation cycle to lift the state to the next scale.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The state at scale Vₙ, with winding number n + 1.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The state at scale Vₙ₊₁, with winding number n + 2, after the punctum transport and frame collapse.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is entropy-conservative because the frame collapse is an idempotent retraction that preserves the fixed-point structure while increasing the scale.

⊢=𐑦: Fixed-point spectral construction implies a scale-invariant state where the boundary encodes the bulk information, collapsing the degrees of freedom into a single register.
⊞=𐑕: The stoichiometric primitive ⊞ implies a higher-order symmetric aggregation of multiple components, consistent with oligomers or committees rather than simple pairs or asymmetric distributions.
⊡=𐑭: Fixed-point spectral constructions are characterized by integer-valued topological invariants (such as winding numbers) that prevent continuous deformation to a trivial state without closing the spectral gap.
⊙=⊙: The assignment of the primitive ⊙ explicitly denotes the critical phase where the system resides at the threshold with scale-free correlations.
⊥=𐑖: Fixed-point spectral construction implies a structurally enforced state with multiple axes, resulting in persistent chirality and a memory depth of n.
≻=𐑽: Fixed-point spectral construction relies on transition-state stabilization to converge eigenvalues without consuming the underlying spectral basis.
≺=𐑿: The primitive ≺ denotes a strict ordering or polarity that establishes a signed direction with a single accepting or donating pole.
⋈=𐑐: Fixed-point spectral construction implies a stable, geometry-enforcing state where interactions fire with near-certainty, maximizing information transmission.
⊤=𐑧: A fixed-point spectral construction implies a kinetically frozen state where the system resists rearrangement without external driving.
∈=𐑚: In fixed-point spectral constructions, interactions typically propagate through localized motifs or clusters to establish mesoscale coherence before reaching global equilibrium.
∋=𐑝: Fixed-point spectral construction requires the simultaneous presence of all spectral components to maintain the stable, self-consistent state defined by the fixed point.
